cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

mechanism: A professionally separates proposal contents from sponsorship to force B to identify which competing claimant B actually backs.
confusable: D55 recruits allies; D58 demands a choice between sides even when B prefers a blended position.
comparison: Election alternative separates friendship from voting day; workshop alternative separates mixed terms from ownership of the proposal.
seedUse: Workshop move, location/budget split, Morgan and compromise derive from D58-a; S03 adds precise sponsorship corrections.
